sn29.6:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca :
sn29.6:1.3: ko nu kho bhante, hetu, ko paccayo, yenamidhekacce opapātikā nāgā uposathaṃ upavasanti vossaṭṭhakāyā ca bhavantīti.
sn29.6:2.1: idha bhikkhu, ekaccānaṃ opapātikānaṃ nāgānaṃ evaṃ hoti :
sn29.6:2.2: “mayaṃ kho pubbe kāyena dvayakārino ahumha, vācāya dvayakārino, manasā dvayakārino.
sn29.6:2.3: te mayaṃ kāyena dvayakārino, vācāya dvayakārino, manasā dvayakārino, kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā opapātikānaṃ nāgānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapannā.
sn29.6:2.4: sacajja mayaṃ kāyena sucaritaṃ careyyāma vācāya sucaritaṃ careyyāma manasā sucaritaṃ careyyāma. evaṃ mayaṃ kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjeyyāma.
sn29.6:2.5: handa mayaṃ etarahi kāyena sucaritaṃ carāma, vācāya sucaritaṃ carāma manasā sucaritaṃ carāmā”ti.
sn29.6:2.6: ayaṃ kho bhikkhu, hetu, ayaṃ paccayo, yenamidhekacce opapātikā nāgā uposathaṃ upavasanti vossaṭṭhakāyā ca bhavantīti.
